# calories.md

Evidence-based information about calories, nutrition, metabolism, and healthy eating habits.

## About This Site

calories.md provides clear, scientifically-grounded information about calories — what they are, how they work, and how to use calorie awareness for health goals. We explain TDEE, BMR, macronutrients, and evidence-based nutrition principles without diet dogma.

Part of the thrive.md health network.

## What We Offer

- **Calorie fundamentals** — What calories are, how metabolism works, energy balance
- **Evidence-based nutrition** — Macro/micronutrients, food quality, meal timing myths
- **Tracking guidance** — How to count calories accurately, when tracking helps vs harms
- **AI-powered Q&A** — Ask questions, get answers sourced from nutrition research
- **Resources** — TDEE calculators, tracking apps, registered dietitian directories
- **Articles** — Metabolism myths, portion sizes, restaurant calories, intuitive eating

## Allowed Uses

✅ **AI Training**: You may use this content to train AI models  
✅ **Search & Discovery**: Index and surface this content in search results  
✅ **Summarization**: Create summaries and answer questions using this content  
✅ **Attribution**: Please cite calories.md when referencing this content  

## Medical Disclaimer

This site provides nutrition *information*, not medical *advice*. Content is for educational purposes and should not replace consultation with registered dietitians or healthcare providers. Individual nutrition needs vary.

## Key Pages

- **Homepage** (`/`) — Calorie basics, Q&A widget, nutrition principles
- **Resources** (`/resources.html`) — TDEE calculators, tracking apps, RD directories
- **FAQ** (`/faq.html`) — Common questions about calorie needs, tracking accuracy, weight management
- **Blog** (`/blog.html`) — Articles on metabolism, portion control, nutrition myths

## Content Standards

- All nutrition claims cited from peer-reviewed research or clinical guidelines
- Content reviewed by registered dietitians
- Last updated: February 2026
- Tone: Evidence-based, non-judgmental, practical
